about: With over 800 completed projects, our team of highly skilled architects, project managers, and engineers provide innovative design solutions along with complete project management for a diverse range of projects, ranging from residential and commercial buildings to luxury villas, townhouse clusters, shopping complexes, mosques to industrial and urban developments.
F. A. Baker Consultants is a well-established architectural consultancy firm that offers a wide range of services to clients in the public and private sectors.
